exposure: Perinatal complications (intrauterine growth restriction, retinopathy of prematurity, necrotizing enterocolitis, stressful conditions)
cohort: The study included 128 neonates (48 preterm) born in Sheba Medical Center and 20 healthy adults as controls.
finding: VWF:Ag and RiCoF levels were significantly elevated in both preterm and term infants compared to adults, while ADAMTS13 levels were significantly higher in preterm babies than in full-term infants and adults, but lower in neonates experiencing stressful conditions or vascular complications.
